title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of member States to ratify and apply international labour standards and to fulfil their reporting obligations

description.narrative: This CPO will support the Government and social partners of Turkmenistan to strengthen application of the Abolition of Forced Labour and Worst Forms of Child Labour Conventions. Within the framework of a roadmap for cooperation, ILO will provide technical support for ratification of fundamental and governance instruments as well as measures to improve legislation, policies and practical actions to prevent and respond to forced labour and child labour during the cotton harvest.
